column5: Name a CMU dictionary headword whose letter score (A=1 to Z=26, added together) is at most 226.
Name a mammal from the published sleep study whose recorded body mass is at most 56 kg (rounded to the nearest kg).
Name a named CSS4 colour whose perceived RGB brightness is at least 201 out of 255 (rounded to an integer).
Name a 2008 car model in the historic fuel-economy dataset that could travel at least 360 highway miles on 15 gallons.
Name a Texas housing market area with a March 2010 median sale price at most $108,200 (nearest $100).
Name a goalscorer at the 2022 men’s World Cup whose earliest listed goal was in minute 60 or later.
Name a Summer Olympics edition (1896–2024) with at most 140 participating nations in the historic series.
Name a Nobel Prize in Literature laureate who received the award in 2000 or later.
Name a U.S. county or county equivalent whose approximate mapped land area is at most 2,074 km² (nearest km²).
Name a U.S. state or Washington, D.C., with at least 358 recorded violent crimes per 100,000 residents in 2009.
Name a country or territory whose historical countryinfo population is at most 25,000,000 people (nearest million).
Name a U.S. president in the 1953–2009 timeline who first took office in 1977 or later.
